Definition: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) to work, serve; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to labour, work, do work; 1a2) to work for another, serve another by labour; 1a3) to serve as subjects; 1a4) to serve (God); 1a5) to serve (with Levitical service); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be worked, be tilled (of land); 1b2) to make oneself a servant; 1c) (Pual) to be worked; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to compel to labour or work, cause to labour, cause to serve; 1d2) to cause to serve as subjects; 1e) (Hophal) to be led or enticed to serve
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
